PERC Score (Pulmonary Embolism Rule-Out Criteria) 
H – No Hormones (oestrogen) 
A – Age < 50 
D – No DVT/PE history 
C – No Coughing blood 
L – No unilateral Lower limb oedema 
O – Oxygen saturations ≥ 95% 
T – No Tachycardia ≥ 100bpm 
S – No Surgery / trauma within 28 days 
ALL need to be confirmed in order to be “PERC Negative”
